description: This file defines a DateRangePicker class for a date range selection UI component, including configuration, rendering, and event handling logic.

classes.name: DateRangePicker
classes.description: A class implementing a date range picker UI component with methods for rendering, event handling, and calendar management.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates the calendar display and input fields based on current start and end dates.

methods.name: updateFromControl
methods.description: Updates the date range based on user input in the associated input field.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Triggers the callback with current start and end dates and updates the display.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Positions the date range picker UI relative to the input element.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the date range picker UI.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the date range picker UI.

methods.name: enterRange
methods.description: Handles hover over predefined date ranges.

methods.name: clickRange
methods.description: Handles selection of a predefined date range.

methods.name: clickPrev
methods.description: Navigates to the previous month in the calendar.

methods.name: clickNext
methods.description: Navigates to the next month in the calendar.

methods.name: enterDate
methods.description: Handles hover over individual date cells.

methods.name: clickDate
methods.description: Handles selection of a specific date.

methods.name: clickApply
methods.description: Applies the selected date range and hides the picker.

methods.name: updateCalendars
methods.description: Rebuilds the calendar views for both months.

methods.name: buildCalendar
methods.description: Constructs a calendar matrix for a given month and year.

methods.name: renderCalendar
methods.description: Generates HTML for a calendar view, highlighting selected and disabled dates.
